title: Slow acceptance of Göbekli Tepe

tellings.quote: It took mainstream archaeology 15 years to accept Göbekli Tepe after Klaus Schmidt started excavating it in 1994.

plain: Michels says that after the archaeologist Klaus Schmidt began digging at Göbekli Tepe, an archaeological site in Turkey, in 1994, it took mainstream archaeology 15 years to accept the site. He tells it himself, as an example of experts being slow to accept finds that do not fit the accepted picture of the past.
